## What changes and why

## Review

- [ ] The change does one thing, and the tests say what it is.
- [ ] Behaviour that can be refused has a test for the refusal.
- [ ] `contracts/storage/AssertDAO.json` is unchanged, or only grows at the end.
- [ ] A change in `contracts/snapshots/GasTest.json` is expected and explained.
- [ ] A change in `web/src/abi/AssertDAO.ts` is matched by the interface that uses it.
- [ ] A change of behaviour bumps the version the contract reports.
